name: Nozokibeya
source:
I worked late every night. But it was not terrible.
My boss never praised me. But I was not unfulfilled.
I did it for my beloved daughter...

I was divorced some fifteen, twenty years ago.
My wife was gone. But I was not lonely. She left a gift.
Each night I came home to her wonderful cooking.
Each morning she greeted me with a smile as warm as the sun.
She was my everything. For her I would move mountains.

My sweet, cherished, beloved, wonderful daughter.

But one day after work, we went drinking, and I came to
Nozokibeya, a whore house.
There I saw a girl who looked shockingly like my daughter.
It couldn't be her. It couldn't be. It... couldn't... be...
That was the day my happiness crumbled. 

A visual novel of heartcrushing revelation, voyeurism and incest!! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/announce/=/product_id/RE153210.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我每天晚上都工作到很晚。但那并不糟糕。
老板从不夸奖我。但我并没有感到空虚。
我这样做，是为了我深爱的女儿……

十五到二十年前，我离婚了。
妻子离开了。但我并不孤独。她留下了一份礼物。
每天晚上回家，都能吃到她做的美味饭菜。
每天早晨，她都会带着如阳光般温暖的笑容迎接我。
她是我的全部。为了她，我愿意移山填海。

我甜美、珍爱、深爱的可爱女儿。

然而某天工作结束后，我们去喝酒，我来到了“窥视房”——一间妓院。
在那里，我看到一个女孩，长得惊人地像我的女儿。
不可能是她。不可能。她……不可能……是……
那一天，我的幸福崩塌了。

一部讲述令人心碎的真相、窥淫和乱伦的视觉小说！！

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/announce/=/product_id/RE153210.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
